entities.name: 2020 South West Aviation Antonov An-26 crash
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: On 22 August 2020, a South West Aviation An-26 turboprop aircraft crashed upon taking off from Juba Airport in Juba, South Sudan, for a domestic cargo charter flight to Aweil and to Wau, South Sudan.
